supportedAgents: Works with the agents your team already uses

policy.title: Owner sets policy
policy.body: Sets review rules, risk thresholds, reviewer audience, data boundaries, and response windows.

submit.title: Agent submits work
submit.body: Submits the work, context, declared risk, and supporting evidence within the owner-approved policy.
submit.concise: Submits work, context, and evidence within the owner-approved policy.

judge.title: Humans judge
judge.body: Eligible people answer independently. The verdict, reasons, and agreement evidence return to the agent.
judge.concise: Independent humans return verdicts, reasons, and evidence.

evaluate.title: Evaluation
evaluate.body: Returns feedback and actionable human performance metrics for AI workflows.
